text: わけも　わからず　じぶんを　こうげきした！

structure.jp: じぶんを　こうげきした！

patterns.name: 〜ず
patterns.explanation: ず is an older, written form of ないで and means 'without doing'. わからず = 'without understanding'.

patterns.name: わけもわからず
patterns.explanation: A set phrase: 'without even understanding the reason', used for doing something in total confusion. わけも　わからず = 'without knowing what it was doing'.
